title: Clip Path Generator
description: Draw a polygon by clicking points on a box and get the matching clip-path CSS with a live preview.
howto: Click anywhere on the canvas to add polygon points (in order).
Use Undo / Clear, or load a preset shape.
Watch the colored box update live as you draw.
Copy the clip-path CSS or download it, then paste it onto any element.

faqs.a: Click on the dotted canvas. Each click adds a vertex in the order you click. Three or more points form a polygon.

faqs.q: Can I remove a single point?
faqs.a: Use Undo to remove the most recently added point, or Clear to start over.

faqs.q: What units does the output use?
faqs.a: Percentages of the element box (x% y%), so the shape scales with any element size.

faqs.q: Why does my shape look wrong?
faqs.a: Points connect in click order — click around the outline of the shape you want, clockwise or counter-clockwise.
